title: Gateway auth_config-delivered list options must accept a comma-separated string
answers: Why does my list-valued Vertex option fail validation when set through the API?
auth_config only supports string values for gateway endpoint settings
How do I pass a list setting to a database-managed gateway endpoint?
comma separated string instead of list in gateway config
body:
Invariant: GatewayModelConfig auth_config is map<string, string> in the service proto, and the REST handler copies it as-is, so any list-typed provider config field that database-managed endpoints can set must also accept a string.
Enforced by mlflow/gateway/config.py:VertexAIConfig.validate_vertex_anthropic_betas (a mode='before' field_validator that splits on commas, strips whitespace, drops empties; '' yields []) and by mlflow/server/gateway_api.py:_build_endpoint_config, which reads the value from auth_config.
What breaks if skipped: a list can never arrive through the API, and a plain or JSON-looking string fails pydantic validation when the first request hits the endpoint, not at endpoint creation.
YAML configs can still pass a real list, so the validator must return non-string values unchanged.
applies: Any new list-typed field on a gateway provider config that is also read from auth_config in mlflow/server/gateway_api.py:_build_endpoint_config.
says: AI Gateway endpoints fail validation when list settings are configured through the API.
Allow entering comma separated values for list options in gateway endpoint configurations.
Requests to managed gateway endpoints fail when provider list options are configured.
Cannot pass multiple configuration options to a gateway model through the management interface.
Setting multiple provider options on a gateway endpoint causes unexpected request errors.
search: List-typed provider configuration fields on database-managed gateway endpoints must accept comma-separated strings because GatewayModelConfig auth_config only supports string key-value mappings. In mlflow/gateway/config.py:VertexAIConfig.validate_vertex_anthropic_betas, a before-mode validator splits comma-separated strings, strips whitespace, drops empty items, and parses empty strings to empty lists. Values are read from auth_config by mlflow/server/gateway_api.py:_build_endpoint_config; without string validation, endpoints fail Pydantic validation on the first request rather than at creation. Non-string values must be returned unchanged to allow YAML configuration files to supply raw lists.
